lines.zh: 我离开王座，石板在脚下碎
lines.en: I leave the throne and the flagstones crack.

lines.zh: 竞技场的沙被我踩出深沟
lines.en: My steps plough deep furrows in the arena sand.

lines.zh: 我拖着脚步走，像拖一座山
lines.en: I drag my steps like dragging a mountain.

lines.zh: 强化过的身体每步都发烫
lines.en: My empowered body runs hot with each step.

lines.zh: 我从睡里走出来，还没完全醒
lines.en: I walk out of sleep, not fully awake.

lines.zh: 四倍的力量压在脚底
lines.en: Four times the power presses through my soles.

lines.zh: 石柱在我经过时晃了一下
lines.en: The pillars sway as I pass.

lines.zh: 我的尾迹里带着热气
lines.en: Heat trails behind my passage.

lines.zh: 我走回场地中央
lines.en: I walk back to the center of the arena.

lines.zh: 我一次迈两格，沙全被推开
lines.en: Two blocks a stride and the sand is pushed aside.

lines.zh: 我在竞技场中沉睡，呼吸很慢
lines.en: I sleep in the arena, breathing slow.

lines.zh: 血条悬在我头顶，那是我的名
lines.en: The boss bar hangs above me: that is my name.

lines.zh: 我坐在石阶上，一动就是半刻
lines.en: I sit on the step and stir only after a long while.

lines.zh: 沉睡时我的气仍压着全场
lines.en: Even asleep, my ki weighs on the whole arena.

lines.zh: 我体内的力量在慢慢涨
lines.en: The power inside me keeps rising.

lines.zh: 火光在场地边缘烧着
lines.en: Fire burns at the arena's edge.

lines.zh: 我的眼皮抬起又落下
lines.en: My eyelids lift and fall.

lines.zh: 这一觉睡得太久了
lines.en: I have slept far too long.

lines.zh: 四壁的符文在我周围亮
lines.en: Runes on the walls glow around me.

lines.zh: 我不动，等有人靠近
lines.en: I keep still, waiting for someone to come near.

lines.zh: 沉睡前我数过场里的柱子
lines.en: I counted the pillars before I slept.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸让沙面起伏
lines.en: My breathing makes the sand rise and fall.

lines.zh: 火光照着我的侧脸
lines.en: Firelight lies along my cheek.

lines.zh: 我梦见自己在打一场没完的架
lines.en: I dream of a fight that never ends.

lines.zh: 我的手垂在石座旁
lines.en: My hand hangs beside the stone seat.

lines.zh: 我动了一下手指，沙落下来
lines.en: I move a finger and sand spills off.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，看着台下的你
lines.en: I open my eyes and look at you below the dais.

lines.zh: 你走近了，我就该醒了
lines.en: You came near; I should wake.

lines.zh: 血条亮起来的那一刻，你该跑
lines.en: When the boss bar lights, you should run.

lines.zh: 我一动，整座竞技场回响
lines.en: I move and the whole arena echoes.

lines.zh: 你站在我睡了千年的地方
lines.en: You stand where I have slept a thousand years.

lines.zh: 我把手按在石栏上
lines.en: I set a hand on the stone rail.

lines.zh: 你的个子在我眼里很小
lines.en: You look very small to me.

lines.zh: 我抬起眼，光暗了下去
lines.en: I lift my eyes and the light dims.

lines.zh: 你不该进这座场
lines.en: You should not have entered this arena.

lines.zh: 我还没有完全清醒
lines.en: I am not fully awake yet.

lines.zh: 你身上没有半点魔气
lines.en: There is not a trace of demon aura on you.

lines.zh: 你带着铁器走进这里
lines.en: You walked in here carrying iron.

lines.zh: 我身上的甲被砍出一道白线
lines.en: A white line is cut across my armor.

lines.zh: 血条晃了一下，我看清了。
lines.en: The health bar flickered. I saw it.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，脚下石板裂
lines.en: I give half a step and the slab cracks.

lines.zh: 我低声咆哮，场地回响
lines.en: I growl low and the arena echoes.

lines.zh: 这一下碰痛了我
lines.en: That one stung.

lines.zh: 我按住被打的地方
lines.en: I press the spot that was struck.

lines.zh: 我的气散了一瞬，又聚起
lines.en: My aura scatters, then gathers again.

lines.zh: 你比我想的更有本事
lines.en: You are more capable than I thought.

lines.zh: 我的甲上多了一道裂
lines.en: A crack has opened in my armor.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，看自己的掌心
lines.en: I raise my hand and look at my own palm.

lines.zh: 你手里拿着什么，放下
lines.en: Whatever you hold, put it down.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，我只需要对手
lines.en: I do not eat; I need an opponent.

lines.zh: 这点东西，连我的牙缝都不够
lines.en: Not enough to fill the gap in my teeth.

lines.zh: 我低头闻了闻，没兴趣
lines.en: I lower my head and sniff; no interest.

lines.zh: 把它放在沙上，退开
lines.en: Set it on the sand and step back.

lines.zh: 我沉睡时不需要进食
lines.en: I need no food while I sleep.

lines.zh: 你带的东西，比我醒着更值钱
lines.en: What you carry is worth more than my waking.

lines.zh: 我看着你的手，不是食物
lines.en: I watch your hands, not the food.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，我低头才能看见
lines.en: Hold it higher; I must lower my head to see.

lines.zh: 我探出一根手指碰了碰
lines.en: I reach out one finger and touch it.

lines.zh: 你一撞上我，就被弹出去
lines.en: You hit me and are thrown clear.

lines.zh: 我的铠甲比墙还硬
lines.en: My armor is harder than a wall.

lines.zh: 我抬脚一挪，你站的地方就没了
lines.en: I shift a foot and your footing is gone.

lines.zh: 相撞的声响在场里回荡
lines.en: The impact echoes around the arena.

lines.zh: 你在我身上弹了两下才落地
lines.en: You bounce off me twice before landing.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，没有退
lines.en: I look down; I have not yielded.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲撞到石柱
lines.en: My shoulder plate strikes a pillar.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的膝盖上，滚开
lines.en: You strike my knee and roll away.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来，让开路
lines.en: I turn my body aside to open the way.

lines.zh: 相撞时我脚下的石板翻起
lines.en: At the impact the slab under me flips up.

lines.zh: 这座场里只有我一个
lines.en: I am alone in this arena.

lines.zh: 我睡了太久，忘了怎么说话
lines.en: I slept too long and forgot how to speak.

lines.zh: 她若在这里，也会守着这座场
lines.en: Were she here, she would guard this arena too.

lines.zh: 我的手掌覆在石座上
lines.en: My palm covers the stone seat.

lines.zh: 石座旁边还有半个位置
lines.en: There is half a seat left beside it.

lines.zh: 我把火拨旺了一些
lines.en: I stir the fire brighter.

lines.zh: 石座上的刻痕被我摸平了
lines.en: I have worn the carvings on the seat smooth.

lines.zh: 我把披风在肩上绕好
lines.en: I wrap the cloak about my shoulders.

lines.zh: 场中没有第二个活物
lines.en: No other living thing in this arena.

lines.zh: 我睡了很久，也等了很久
lines.en: I have slept long, and waited longer.

lines.zh: 我弯下腰，地面跟着沉
lines.en: I bend and the ground sinks with me.

lines.zh: 我拾起一块崩落的石片
lines.en: I pick up a fallen shard of stone.

lines.zh: 把它放在掌心，它碎成了粉
lines.en: It crumbles to powder in my palm.

lines.zh: 我拾起挑战者留下的兵器
lines.en: I pick up a weapon a challenger left.

lines.zh: 这些兵器我收在石阶下
lines.en: I keep these weapons beneath the step.

lines.zh: 我把东西扔回沙里
lines.en: I toss it back into the sand.

lines.zh: 我拾起一片断掉的箭羽
lines.en: I pick up a snapped arrow's fletching.

lines.zh: 挑战者的剑柄在我掌心碎了。
lines.en: The challenger's sword hilt crumbles in my palm.

lines.zh: 沙里的东西我一件件挑出来
lines.en: I sort the things out of the sand one by one.

lines.zh: 我把石片叠在一起
lines.en: I stack the stone shards together.

lines.zh: 我站起来，影子盖住半个场
lines.en: I rise and my shadow covers half the arena.

lines.zh: 血条满了，你的名字已经写上
lines.en: The bar is full; your name is already written.

lines.zh: 你踏进了我的苏醒范围
lines.en: You have entered my waking range.

lines.zh: 我一低头，眼睛锁住你
lines.en: I lower my head and my eyes lock on you.

lines.zh: 整座竞技场开始震
lines.en: The whole arena begins to shake.

lines.zh: 我不必追，你会自己过来
lines.en: I need not chase; you will come to me.

lines.zh: 四倍的力气在我手里醒了
lines.en: Fourfold strength wakes in my hands.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，气流压下去
lines.en: I raise a hand and the air presses down.

lines.zh: 石柱上的符文全亮了
lines.en: Every rune on the pillars lights.

lines.zh: 这一战，我等你很久了
lines.en: I have waited long for this fight.

lines.zh: 血条开始一点点减少
lines.en: The bar begins to tick down.

lines.zh: 我把全身重量往前送
lines.en: I push my whole weight forward.

lines.zh: 沙面被我的气势压平
lines.en: The sand flattens under my presence.

lines.zh: 你退到场边，也要打
lines.en: Retreat to the edge and you still must fight.

lines.zh: 我把拳头举到肩高
lines.en: I raise my fist to shoulder height.

lines.zh: 我把这场比赛看作苏醒
lines.en: I treat this fight as my waking.

lines.zh: 你站在沙上，我在你头上
lines.en: You stand on the sand; I stand above you.

lines.zh: 符文一路亮到我脚下
lines.en: Runes light all the way to my feet.

lines.zh: 我不快，可我从不停止靠近
lines.en: I am not fast, but I never stop closing.

lines.zh: 你跑到场边，那就是我的地
lines.en: Run to the arena's edge; it is still mine.

lines.zh: 我的脚一落，沙就往下沉
lines.en: My foot falls and the sand sinks.

lines.zh: 你的攻击打在我身上像风
lines.en: Your blows land on me like wind.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，缓慢而确定
lines.en: I raise my hand, slow and certain.

lines.zh: 你会累，我不会
lines.en: You will tire; I will not.

lines.zh: 我一步一步压缩你的空间
lines.en: Step by step I take your space.

lines.zh: 场边的火被我的气吹高
lines.en: The edge fires leap with my aura.

lines.zh: 血条一点没动，你该明白
lines.en: The bar has not moved; you should understand.

lines.zh: 你绕到柱子后面，柱子不够粗
lines.en: You hide behind a pillar; it is too thin.

lines.zh: 我抬手拍向石柱
lines.en: I swing my hand at the pillar.

lines.zh: 你不能离开这座场
lines.en: You cannot leave this arena.

lines.zh: 我一伸手就够到对面墙
lines.en: One reach of my hand touches the far wall.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，我就进一步
lines.en: Every step you yield, I take one.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛跟着你不放
lines.en: My eyes never leave you.

lines.zh: 你的气越来越薄
lines.en: Your stamina grows thinner.

lines.zh: 我抬手在沙上划出一道线
lines.en: I draw a line in the sand with my hand.

lines.zh: 我把你往场中央逼
lines.en: I drive you toward the arena's center.

lines.zh: 石柱被我撞断了一根
lines.en: I have broken one of the pillars.

lines.zh: 你绕着圈跑，圈在缩小
lines.en: You circle; the circle shrinks.

lines.zh: 我一掌拍下，沙像浪一样散开
lines.en: My palm lands and the sand scatters like surf.

lines.zh: 我的拳头砸在地上，地裂开
lines.en: My fist hits the ground and it splits.

lines.zh: 气功波从我掌心推出去
lines.en: A ki wave pushes from my palm.

lines.zh: 我一脚踢得你撞上石墙
lines.en: A kick sends you into the stone wall.

lines.zh: 我抬肘下压，整个场地一沉
lines.en: My elbow drives down and the arena drops.

lines.zh: 你挡了一下，手臂在抖
lines.en: You block once and your arm shakes.

lines.zh: 我一拳打空，砸碎了地面
lines.en: My fist misses and shatters the floor.

lines.zh: 我的指头弹在你身上
lines.en: My finger flicks into you.

lines.zh: 我抓你的时候差点捏住
lines.en: I nearly catch you when I grab.

lines.zh: 我被你打中，退了一步
lines.en: You land a hit; I take one step.

lines.zh: 我砸下第二拳，沙飞得很高
lines.en: I hammer a second fist and the sand flies.

lines.zh: 我用肩撞断旁边一根石柱
lines.en: I ram a pillar and snap it.

lines.zh: 我的手掌贴地推过去
lines.en: I push my palm flat along the ground.

lines.zh: 我一口气把火吹得更高
lines.en: My breath drives the fire higher.

lines.zh: 竞技场中央的石座裂了
lines.en: The stone seat at the arena's center cracks.

lines.zh: 我先睁开一只眼
lines.en: I open one eye first.

lines.zh: 血条在我头顶浮出来
lines.en: The boss bar surfaces above my head.

lines.zh: 整座魔界竞技场的沙开始下沉
lines.en: The arena sand sinks under my weight.

lines.zh: 我从千年沉睡里站起来
lines.en: I rise from a thousand years of sleep.

lines.zh: 四倍的力量回来了
lines.en: Fourfold power returns.

lines.zh: 符文一路亮到我脚边
lines.en: Runes light all the way to my feet.

lines.zh: 我的铠甲上落满灰，我一抖就散
lines.en: Dust covers my armor; one shake clears it.

lines.zh: 有人闯进了不该进的地方
lines.en: Someone entered where none should.

lines.zh: 我踏出王座，石阶碎了
lines.en: I step off the dais and the stair shatters.

lines.zh: 沙从我的甲缝里往下漏
lines.en: Sand leaks from the seams of my armor.

lines.zh: 我把头转了一圈，脖子在响
lines.en: I roll my head and the neck creaks.

lines.zh: 我垂下手臂，指节碰到沙
lines.en: I let my arm fall and my knuckles touch sand.

lines.zh: 火光把我的影子拉满整场
lines.en: Firelight stretches my shadow across the arena.

lines.zh: 我睁开另一只眼
lines.en: I open the other eye.

lines.zh: 我从沙里站起来，沙往下滑
lines.en: I rise from the sand and it slides off me.

lines.zh: 我看向场地入口
lines.en: I look toward the arena's entrance.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，把碎石踩成粉
lines.en: I step and grind the rubble to dust.

lines.zh: 我睡够，来的人也太迟
lines.en: I have slept enough, and my visitor is late.

lines.zh: 我把角上的灰抖掉
lines.en: I shake the dust from my horns.

lines.zh: 火在我甲上烧，我甩了甩手
lines.en: Fire burns on my armor; I shake my hand.

lines.zh: 我从石座上跌下，砸出一个坑
lines.en: I fall from the seat and smash a crater.

lines.zh: 水淹到我的胸口，我的气被压住
lines.en: Water reaches my chest and pins my aura.

lines.zh: 爆风掀动了我的铠甲
lines.en: The blast shifts my armor.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我的甲缝
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my armor's seam.

lines.zh: 咒文缠在我的角上，勒得发紧
lines.en: Spells coil round my horns and pull tight.

lines.zh: 饥饿在沉睡里也该结束
lines.en: Even in slumber, hunger should end.

lines.zh: 雷落在我的角上，一路烧到肩
lines.en: Lightning strikes my horns and burns to my shoulder.

lines.zh: 脚下裂开虚空，我往下坠
lines.en: The void opens below and I fall.
